mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS session_id, w.candidate_id, s.session_version FROM mini_program_session s JOIN wechat_identity w ON w.id = s.wechat_identity_id JOIN app_user u ON u.id = w.candidate_id WHERE s.token_digest = #{digest} AND w.app_id = #{appId} AND s.revoked_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at > #{now} AND s.session_version = u.session_version AND u.account_kind = 'CANDIDATE' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'
